thread:
alina: Quick sync — Lumen wants to formalize the sim-bench telemetry contract + perf/W sweep. Need to lock down test matrix, telemetry schema, and delivery SLA. Looping in @priya, @marco, @jens. @taylor from Lumen will post infra details. Proposed kickoff Mon 10am PT. Any blockers?

taylor (Lumen HW): We can provide rack-level power traces, per-card thermal sensors, and kernel perf counters. Delivery options: CSV dumps + a read-only Prometheus `remote_write` endpoint. Initial matrix: 2 models (open-gpt-medium variant), seq len 2048, batch sizes 1/8/32, quantized int8 + fp16 runs. Which kernel symbols do you want instrumented?

priya: Sweet — for telemetry we'll need per-token latency histograms, GPU power sampled at 1s, board-level TDP headroom, and kernel flamegraphs. Kernel list: `matmul`, `attention`, `layernorm`, `softmax`. NVLINK counters if available. Also need KV-cache hit logs (timestamped) to correlate cache efficacy -> perf/W.

taylor (Lumen HW): NVLINK counters can be exported. KV-cache hits: we can emit aggregated logs at 1min cadence (JSON lines). Is that acceptable for the first sweep?

marco: Per-minute KV logs are OK for initial throughput curves. For regression hunting we prefer per-request granularity, but we can iterate. We'll drive a 1k prompt harness (steady-state) — can you run each config for 4 hours? We'll supply the docker image + runbook.

alina: Action items so far: Lumen to share sample CSV + prometheus endpoint creds by EOD Thu. Redwood to send the harness docker + runbook by Wed. Legal to confirm data-sharing terms — @rebecca-legal can you take point?

rebecca-legal: Quick note — telemetry must be anonymized; no customer payloads or keys. I'll draft a one-page DPA amendment (data use & retention) and circulate by Friday morning. If Lumen needs an SLA for retention let me know.

jens: From infra side: we'll need a jumpbox for controlled scrapes (read-only), and an allowlist for our IPs. Security checklist here: https://redwood.internal/sec-checklist (short). Also prefer prometheus TLS + mTLS.

taylor (Lumen HW): Confirmed — we can spin up a read-only Prometheus instance behind mTLS and a jumpbox. ETA for sample artifacts: EOD Friday. We'll include a small example `remote_write` snippet: ```remote_write:
  - url: "https://prom.redwood-lumen.example/api/v1/write"
    tls_config:
      ca_file: "/etc/prom/certs/ca.pem"
```

alina: :thumbsup: I'll create the Jira epic and assign tasks. Tentative kickoff Mon 10am PT — I'll send the calendar invite and include the runbook link. If anyone has additional must-haves for the first sweep call them out now.

alina: (followup) calendar invite sent + meeting notes channel thread created. Thanks everyone!
